question: A does a work in 10 days and B does the same work in 15 days. How much part of the work is completed in 2 days if they work together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 10 and 15 = 30 (Total Work)

⇒ A's efficiency = 30 ÷ 10 = 3

⇒ B's efficiency = 30 ÷ 15 = 2

⇒ Together = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day

⇒ In 2 days = 5 × 2 = 10 units = 10 ÷ 30 = 1 ÷ 3

**∴ Answer = 1 ÷ 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A completes work in 10 days

B completes work in 15 days

**LCM Method Table:**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work done in 2 days = 5 × 2 = 10

⇒ Fraction of work = 10 ÷ 30 = 1 ÷ 3

**∴ Work completed = 1 ÷ 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**LCM Advantage:** Converts fractional work into integers for faster calculation.

**Efficiency Rule:** Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

**Combined Efficiency:** Add efficiencies when working together.

**Work Fraction:** Work done = (Work completed ÷ Total work)
